packageRules.description: Bump so npm updates edit package.json and package-lock.json together — avoids lockfile-mirror drift in npm workspaces (see renovatebot/renovate#28797)
The engines.node constraint is a deliberate minimum (set to match a tooling requirement), not something to auto-bump to the latest release

A tag is a mutable ref: whoever owns the action can move it and run their code in CI. Pinning to a digest is the only immutable form; Renovate keeps the digest and its version comment current afterwards. release.yml is exempt via ignorePaths — dist generates it, and its pins live in dist-workspace.toml
